# Social Welfare History Project

> > A comprehensive digital archive documenting the history of social welfare, social work education, and reform movements in the United States from the 19th century through the New Deal era.

Hosted by VCU Libraries, this project preserves primary documents, biographies, and historical analyses of key figures, institutions, and legislation that shaped American social welfare policy. The collection emphasizes Progressive Era reforms, the development of professional social work, and landmark programs like Social Security.

## Key Topics

- Progressive Era reform
- Social Security history
- New Deal programs
- Social work education
- Hull-House and settlement movement
- Child labor reform
- Public assistance programs
- National Conference of Charities and Corrections
- Unemployment insurance
- Civil rights and March on Washington
- Charlotte Towle
- Jane Addams
- Great Depression welfare policy
- Federal-state welfare programs
- NASW (National Association of Social Workers)

## Major Legislation and Programs

- [Social Security Act of 1935](https://socialwelfare.library.vcu.edu/social-security/social-security-act-of-1935): FDR's 1935 Social Security Act & New Deal federal welfare legislation
- [Federal-State Public Welfare Programs](https://socialwelfare.library.vcu.edu/public-welfare/federal-state-public-welfare-programs): Federal-state welfare programs from Progressive Era to Great Depression
- [Widows Pensions: An Introduction](https://socialwelfare.library.vcu.edu/programs/widows-pensions-an-introduction): Progressive Era widows pensions & mothers' aid in NYC
- [Economic Security: Part II](https://socialwelfare.library.vcu.edu/programs/economic-security-part-ii-2): Social Security history & Industrial Revolution economic changes
- [Employment Services: A Brief History](https://socialwelfare.library.vcu.edu/programs/employment-services-a-brief-history): Federal employment services & unemployment insurance history

## Historical Timeline and Eras

- [Social Welfare Developments, 1800-1850](https://socialwelfare.library.vcu.edu/events/1800-1850): 19th century social welfare timeline: poorhouses to labor reform

## Reform Movements and Civil Rights

- [March on Washington, DC: Final Organization Plans](https://socialwelfare.library.vcu.edu/eras/final-organization-plans): March on Washington organizational plans & civil rights documents
- [Jane Addams' and Rev. Edgar Murphy's Views on Child Labor Reform in 1903](https://socialwelfare.library.vcu.edu/programs/hild-labor-reform-views-1903): Jane Addams & Rev. Murphy on 1903 child labor reform at Hull-House
- [American Labor Party: 1936](https://socialwelfare.library.vcu.edu/organizations/labor/american-labor-party-1936): 1936 American Labor Party formation in New York State

## Social Work Thought and Education

- [Towle, Charlotte: A Perspective](https://socialwelfare.library.vcu.edu/issues/towle-charlotte-fitting-her-into-the-history-of-welfare-thought-in-the-u-s): Charlotte Towle's welfare thought & U of Chicago social work legacy
- [Corrections: Part VII – Trends In Criminology – 1924](https://socialwelfare.library.vcu.edu/corrections/corrections-part-vii-trends-in-criminology-1924): S. Sheldon Glueck on 1924 criminology trends at Harvard

## Biographies of Social Welfare Pioneers

- [van Kleeck, Mary](https://socialwelfare.library.vcu.edu/people/van-kleeck-mary): Mary van Kleeck biography: settlement worker & labor reform advocate
- [Devine, Edward T.](https://socialwelfare.library.vcu.edu/people/devine-edward-t-3): Edward T. Devine: Charity Organization Society & social work education
- [Lindeman, Eduard](https://socialwelfare.library.vcu.edu/people/lindman-eduard): Eduard Lindeman: adult education pioneer & social philosophy advocate
- [Vaile, Gertrude](https://socialwelfare.library.vcu.edu/people/vaile-gertrude): Gertrude Vaile: Denver social work pioneer & casework principles leader
- [Beck, Bertram M.](https://socialwelfare.library.vcu.edu/people/beck-bertram-m): Bertram Beck biography: settlement house leader & NASW figure
- [Hillman, Arthur J.](https://socialwelfare.library.vcu.edu/people/hillman-arthur-j): Arthur Hillman: Hull-House & Roosevelt University urban sociologist

## Contemporary Scholars and Educators

- [Peebles-Wilkins, Wilma, Ph.D.](https://socialwelfare.library.vcu.edu/biography/peebles-wilkins-wilma-ph-d): Biography of Wilma Peebles-Wilkins, Boston U social work dean emerita
- [Vourlekis, Betsy Schaefer, Ph.D.](https://socialwelfare.library.vcu.edu/biography/vourlekis-betsy-schaefer-ph-d): Betsy Vourlekis: U of Maryland psychiatric & health social work professor

## Optional

- [Pendergast Machine](https://socialwelfare.library.vcu.edu/people/pendergast-machine): Kansas City Pendergast political machine & Truman connection history
